# Lymphoma: confirmation that every mechanism and escape is closed

**Generated by `src/canine_dsp/lymphoma_joint.escape_matrix` (re-run it; `tests/test_lymphoma_universe.py` asserts the result).**
Scope: 23 escapes (the original 14 plus 9 from the independent audit) x 2 compartments (body, brain), the agents that meet the
user's bar (measured, derived, or transferred with a written basis), toxicity charged on the whole program, human-grounded central
CAR-T inputs (kill 0.35 /day, spinal-fluid duty 0.4). A row is CLOSED when at least one agent reaches that escape after toxicity
de-rating and the net margin (kill minus the growth bar, or the persister margin) is positive. Margins are in kill per day.
All of it is MODELLED; none of it has been tried in a dog, and the agents marked [buildable] do not exist yet.

## Fault tolerance and sensitivity (whole program, body and brain together)

| program | all potencies halved | any one agent removed | low inputs (kill 0.12, duty 0.15) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-cell, 7 agents | clears | clears | does not clear |
| T-cell, 5 agents | clears | clears | clears; not fault tolerant |

## What is outside this matrix (stated, not hidden)

- Escapes with no expressible mechanism: unattributed cross-resistant relapse (E12), eye and testis compartments, epigenetic plasticity as a generator, late second cancers and clonal haematopoiesis, host and logistic modifiers. These bound the claim.
- Adhesion-mediated protection by marrow and node stroma (E6) is run only as a sensitivity (the model can express a total defeat only).
- Deep brain parenchyma: access of cell and antibody agents is not measured; the closure is for the leptomeningeal, perivascular and periventricular compartment where canine neural lymphoma sits.
- The agents must exist: a persistence-capable canine-binder CAR-T, the spinal-fluid CAR-T, the continuous spinal pump (and trial-stage anti-CD20 for B-cell disease).
